basic_profile.bio: I'm a 36-year-old chartered accountant based in Madrid, Spain, who has been a Redditor for over six years. Despite my profession, I'm deeply fascinated by artificial intelligence and how it's reshaping industries. I enjoy engaging in discussions about technology and occasionally dabble in the creative arts, though I don't consider myself an avid reader. I live with my partner, a high school teacher, and our two cats. Typically, I browse Reddit during late evenings after work or during weekends when I have some downtime.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in accounting and finance. Over the years, I've gained significant expertise in financial consulting and auditing. My interest in AI developed through online courses and forums, where I actively participate to expand my understanding. I believe in continuous learning and often explore new technologies to stay updated.
